comments.text: Absolutely magical. This cliffside village looks like something from a fairy tale, and the dramatic location makes it hard to believe such a place could really exist.

comments.author: @Aventurex-686
comments.text: This village looks like something that escaped from a fairy tale before anyone noticed. Perched on a cliff, it somehow makes gravity seem optional. Meanwhile, I still hold the handrail walking up ordinary stairs.
